description_expanded: Breezy Gulf views, fresh designer interiors, and a prime location in the gated community of Old Florida Beach make Just Beachy an unforgettable 30A retreat. This fully renovated vacation home features 7 bedrooms, 5.5 bathrooms, and comfortably sleeps up to 13 guests in its main house and private carriage house. With a private pool, charming porches, and thoughtful touches throughout, this property blends modern coastal design with laid-back vacation comfort. Inside the main house, a relaxed palette of driftwood tones, soft whites, and coastal blue accents cascades over wide-plank floors and shiplap walls. The open living and dining area is ideal for gathering, with plush seating, a large smart TV, and French doors leading to the poolside porch. The stunning kitchen boasts quartz countertops, a gas range, stainless steel appliances, and custom cabinetry accented by marble herringbone tile. Each bedroom is its own peaceful escape — including the third-floor Primary Suite with a king bed, Gulf-view balcony, spa-like bathroom, and access to a private porch. Additional guest rooms include a second king bedroom on the main level, a serene queen suite, a cheerful bunk room with two twin-over-twin bunks and private bath, and a sunny bedroom with two twin beds — all with access to beautifully updated bathrooms featuring statement mirrors, coastal light fixtures, and fresh tilework. Outdoors, palm trees and a white picket fence frame your private oasis. The 10x20-foot pool (seasonally heatable) is flanked by loungers, a pergola-shaded dining area, and a convenient outdoor half-bath. The second-story carriage house offers a vibrant, self-contained space with aqua-blue walls, rattan furnishings, a retro-style fridge, and its own living area, full kitchen, two bedrooms (queen and twin), and a shared bath. It's perfect for extended family or guests who prefer a little extra privacy. The sugar-white sand is just a short 2-minute walk away via Old Florida Beac h’s private beach access. Guests also enjoy use of the neighborhood’s seasonally heated community pool and quiet streets ideal for biking and sunset strolls. A short walk brings you to Goatfeathers and Local Catch, two beloved local spots known for fresh seafood and casual coastal vibes. Just beyond, Gulf Place offers boutique shopping, cafés, and live music on the green. For nature lovers, nearby coastal dune lakes and scenic trails provide even more ways to explore 30A’s beauty. Extras include dual laundry areas, smart TVs in every bedroom, ample parking, and strong Wi-Fi throughout. Whether you're planning a multigenerational getaway or a coastal vacation with friends, Just Beachy makes it easy to settle in and soak up everything 30A has to offer. Main House: First Floor: Large Living Room with Patio Access, Full Kitchen, Dining Room, King Bedroom, Full Bathroom, Half Bathroom, Laundry Room. Second Floor: Queen Bedroom with Shared Bathroom, Twin Bunk Room with Private Bathroom, Bedroom with Two Twin Beds and Shared Bathroom. Third Floor: King Primary Bedroom with Large Private Bathroom + Balcony Access. Guest House: First Floor: Half Bathroom Second Floor: Living Room, Full Kitchen, Queen Bedroom with Shared Hall Bathroom, Twin Bedroom, Laundry. *Add $50.00 per day to heat the pool (available October – April if needed). Based on daily temperatures and at the HOA’s discretion, the community pool is typically heated during the fall and holiday weeks. The use of golf carts is prohibited in the Old Florida Beach community.
